# `collab/SpatialHashGrid.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/SpatialHashGrid.js`

SpatialHashGrid.js O(1) spatial lookup grid for interest management and zone queries. Uses a 2D grid (XZ plane) where each cell stores a Set of entity IDs. Supports radius and AABB queries without iterating all entities. Inspired by: Photon Fusion AoI grid, SpatialOS worker partitioning.

### `gridQueryRadius(grid, x, z, radius)`

Query all entity IDs within a radius of a point (XZ plane). Returns entities whose grid position is within the radius.

**Parameters:**

- `grid` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `x` *(number)* — Center X
- `z` *(number)* — Center Z
- `radius` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** matching entity IDs

### `gridQueryRect(grid, minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ)`

Query all entity IDs within an axis-aligned bounding box (XZ plane).
